name: agent-builder-model-map-scope
body: Law (prose; assessed by review): the repo's `opencode.json` agent→model map is part of the agent-builder's MAIN-write carve-out, alongside `.opencode/agents/**` — a second write path under the SAME carve-out (`global.constraint.worktree-isolation` counts exactly TWO agent carve-outs). The map lives under the opencode 2.x `agents` key, and a model reference carrying a variant joins it as `provider/model#variant`. The map is maintained NON-DESTRUCTIVELY: a write adds/updates only the `agents.<name>.model` entries the interview produced and preserves every other key and every existing entry unless the interview changes it. `codebase-navigator` is EXCLUDED — no `agents.codebase-navigator.model` entry may be written. The agent-builder's only git mutation is `git add`/`git commit`; push/tag is the optional release-agent's sole `ask` grant.
